corpus.clone: git clone --depth 1 <repo> firefox (then verify HEAD == commit)

answer_format: End your reply with a fenced code block tagged `answer` that contains one item per line (exactly the kind of item the question asks for) and nothing else.

questions.prompt: List every file in this repository that #includes netwerk/protocol/http/nsHttpChannel.h directly, with any include spelling. Search the whole tree. Answer items: repository-relative file paths.
Where is the C++ class nsHttpChannel defined (the class definition with its body, not a forward declaration)? Answer item: one path:line.
Under netwerk/, which C++ classes declare or define the method OnStartRequest(nsIRequest*)? Exclude overloads with other parameter types. Answer items: class names without namespaces.

Which C/C++ files call the function NS_GetFinalChannelURI? Count only real calls, not declarations, definitions, comments or strings. Search the whole tree. Answer items: repository-relative file paths.
